Thanks for the context — quick technical notes from SE side:

- Peak TPS: 25 TPS with short bursts (30–60s) is well within our hosted platform capabilities, but cost model changes if you require guaranteed sustained throughput vs best-effort burst.
- Tokenization & avg token estimate: your 280-token average aligns with our modeling. We'll recommend continuous prefix caching for shorter repeated prompts — that can reduce effective token consumption by ~10–20% depending on prompt reuse.
- Batching & latency: for short prompts we use continuous batching; you should expect slightly better unit economics during high-concurrency windows. For spiky traffic, enabling burst capacity + autoscale reduces tail latency.

Action items for FintechX (what we'd need to finalize sizing & a firm price):
1) A 24–48 hour sample of prod logs (sanitized) or the aggregated per-minute TPS and tokens.
2) Clarify regional split (US-only vs EU/APAC).

I'll attach a short tech note and link to the hosted API docs on bursting. If you can drop the sample logs to the Drive link below (or attach here), we'll run a quick sizing + cost model and include in Marissa's proposal.
